## Observed behavior and expected behavior

## Minimal reproducible example

Use synthetic or shareable aggregate data. Do not include private participant
records or credentials.

## Numerical status

Report calibration, tolerance, max_splits, status, converged, termination,
endpoint_gaps, and outward_rounding_certified.

## Environment

Package version, sessionInfo(), operating system, and compiler if relevant.
